mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cover_posts (HOPE_JOB, HOPE_REGION, EDUCATION, MILITARY_STATUS, CAREER, KEYSKILL, CERTIFICATION, LANGUAGE_SKILL, APPLY_MOTIVE, GROWTH_PROCESS, PERSONALITY, JOB_EXPERIENCE, IMAGE_URL, JOBSEEKER_IDX) VALUES (#{hopeJob}, #{hopeRegion}, #{education}, #{militaryStatus}, #{career}, #{keySkill}, #{certification}, #{languageSkill}, #{applyMotive}, #{growthProcess}, #{personality}, #{jobExperience}, #{imageUrl}, #{jobseekerIdx})
mapper.select: select JOBSEEKER_NAME, JOBSEEKER_BIRTH, JOBSEEKER_EMAIL, JOBSEEKER_PHONE from jobseeker_users where JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE cover_posts SET HOPE_JOB = #{hopeJob}, HOPE_REGION = #{hopeRegion}, EDUCATION = #{education}, MILITARY_STATUS = #{militaryStatus}, CAREER = #{career}, KEYSKILL = #{keySkill}, CERTIFICATION = #{certification}, LANGUAGE_SKILL = #{languageSkill}, APPLY_MOTIVE = #{applyMotive}, GROWTH_PROCESS = #{growthProcess}, PERSONALITY = #{personality}, JOB_EXPERIENCE = #{jobExperience}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl} WHERE JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx}
mapper.select: select HOPE_JOB, HOPE_REGION, EDUCATION, MILITARY_STATUS, CAREER, KEYSKILL, CERTIFICATION, LANGUAGE_SKILL, APPLY_MOTIVE, GROWTH_PROCESS, PERSONALITY, JOB_EXPERIENCE, IMAGE_URL from cover_posts where JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{value} limit 1
